title: Training instructor's account of 'ghosts' using the Nellis weather station restroom
place_text: Old weather station, base operations building, Nellis AFB, Nevada

tellings.quote: ghosts, you and I would say a group of five tall white aliens had come in off the runway off the the tarmac

plain: In 1964 or 1965, at the old weather station in the base operations building at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, an airman training new staff on the job told the young Charles Hall that 'ghosts' sometimes came in to use the restroom. Hall, who says he later spent years in contact with tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites and who wrote about it in his book Millennial Hospitality, tells Michels that the 'ghosts' were really 'a group of five tall white aliens' who had walked in off the runway. If true, it would mean beings like these were walking around a working Air Force base, and the staff had a cover word for them.
